A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Curious?
Let's talk.

Getting to know your new co-pilot.

What is ReplyVibe?+

ReplyVibe is a Chrome extension that helps you write AI-powered, human-like replies on X. Choose a tone, review the suggestion, and make it your own.

Can I install it right now?+

Not just yet. ReplyVibe is currently in Chrome Web Store review. The install link will be available here after approval.

Can I change the tone and language?+

Yes. ReplyVibe includes tones such as Professional, Friendly, Funny, Roast, and Supportive, with support for English, Hindi, Gujarati, and Hinglish.

Does it post replies automatically?+

You choose what to share. Review the generated reply, edit it if you like, then copy or insert it into X before posting.

Is the demo using live AI?+

The demo on this page uses sample replies to show how different tones feel. The Chrome extension is where you can generate replies for your own conversations.
